details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/templates/serena_project.yml.j2:4-70 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The Serena project template includes languages that Serena v1.2.0 rejects, causing initialization to fail.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers observed unsupported entries such as angular/html/scss triggering an invalid-language error before the MCP handshake can complete.
- scripts/setup_serena.sh:13-14 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: SERENA_PROJECT_PATH is derived from the script location instead of the active workspace.
  WHY: In staged-script workflows, this writes .serena/project.yml to the wrong repository root.
- scripts/setup_serena.sh:292-299 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: render_serena_project unconditionally overwrites an existing .serena/project.yml.
  WHY: Repositories with custom Serena settings lose them when the bootstrap runs.
- scripts/setup_serena.sh:13,292-299 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: render_serena_project depends on templates/serena_project.yml.j2 being present beside the script.
  WHY: Consumer deployments that stage only scripts/ fail when the template directory is absent.
- scripts/mcp_handshake_probe.py:213-234 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: stderr is piped but not drained during the handshake, so verbose servers can block on stderr writes.
  WHY: The child can fill the pipe buffer before initialize completes, causing a timeout despite a healthy server.
- scripts/mcp_handshake_probe.py:301-306 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: stderr is only drained after failure in cleanup, not while the handshake is in progress.
  WHY: A verbose server can still block on stderr during active probing and never reach the initialize response.
- scripts/mcp_handshake_probe.py:226-234 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The explicit None check on proc.stdin/proc.stdout is unreachable when subprocess.PIPE is used.
  WHY: Popen either returns pipe objects or raises OSError, so this branch cannot fire.
- scripts/mcp_handshake_probe.py:145,301-306 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: Both the reader loop and the main probe catch BaseException.
  WHY: Catching BaseException includes KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit and can delay clean shutdown.
- scripts/mcp_handshake_probe.py:291 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: probe_initialize still catches BaseException.
  WHY: This broad catch can interfere with signal handling even though cleanup re-raises afterward.
- scripts/serena_stats_emit.py:121-124,148-153 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The log emitter reads entire files into memory before parsing.
  WHY: Large Codex logs can cause memory pressure or OOM on constrained runners.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  WHY: In consumer-repo workflows, support scripts staged under RUNNER_TEMP write .serena/project.yml to the wrong location.
- scripts/setup_serena.sh:292-299 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: render_serena_project unconditionally overwrites any existing project.yml.
  WHY: Repositories with custom Serena settings lose them when the bootstrap runs.
- scripts/mcp_handshake_probe.py:226-234 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: stderr=subprocess.PIPE is never read during the handshake.
  WHY: A verbose MCP server can fill the pipe buffer and block before it processes initialize.
- scripts/mcp_handshake_probe.py:291 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: probe_initialize catches BaseException.
  WHY: Catching BaseException can interfere with shutdown and signal handling.
- scripts/serena_stats_emit.py:150 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: path.read_text() loads the entire log file into memory.
  WHY: Large Codex logs can cause memory pressure on constrained runners.
